title: Take the Shark Valley tram into the Everglades
description: Settle into a guided tram at Shark Valley and follow the paved loop through open Everglades wetland. A naturalist points out the details that are easy to miss from a car: wading birds, alligators, water patterns, and the life of the slough. You can experience a broad slice of the park while remaining seated, then choose a short stop if you wish.
teaser: Explore the Everglades from a naturalist-led tram.
goodToKnow: January-February dry season is often favorable. Confirm tram accessibility and departure times.
whyItMightDelightYou: The landscape can look empty at first; the guide helps it reveal how much is moving around you.
